verdict.rationale: Square exposes a Payouts API (List Payouts) and Payments-related SDK/API calls plus webhooks for transaction events, and now ships an official MCP server, giving an AI agent the building blocks to pull payments/payouts data programmatically. However, there's no explicit documented 'List Payments/Transactions' endpoint or any built-in reconciliation/ledger-matching feature—reconciliation would have to be assembled by the agent from raw API data. Missing for 10: explicit transactions-list API evidence, dedicated reconciliation/ledger tooling, and independent confirmation of MCP server reliability for this workflow.
